ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: harmony
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: End the feuds: no two colonists who can't stand each other. Separate rooms, shared shifts, parties, whatever it takes.

plain.li: Half of us aren't speaking to the other half. Raiders don't need to kill us; we're doing fine on our own.
Every dinner is a cold war. Can we fix that before it turns hot?
[afterraid] We fought side by side yesterday. Today the same two people won't pass the salt.

warm.li: I want us to be a family. Families fight, but they make up. Let's make up.

blunt.li: Everyone who hates someone: knock it off. That's the whole ambition.

cheerful.li: Group hug! Mandatory! For everyone! Especially the grumpy ones!

gloomy.li: We're too few to be enemies. One day it'll come down to one of us saving another, and they'll hesitate.

cold.li: Feuds cost us fights, breakdowns and wasted hours. Eliminating them is pure gain.

plain.li: Nobody's at anybody's throat. I'm almost suspicious.

warm.li: Look at everyone, laughing at the same table. That's what I wanted.

cheerful.li: Peace! Love! Nobody threw a spoon at dinner!

cold.li: Interpersonal conflict resolved. Productivity should follow.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: a council worth trusting
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Win back the colony's trust: grant wishes, keep promises, heed petitions. Everyone works better for a council they believe in.

plain.li: People have stopped asking the council for anything. That's not peace. That's giving up.
Keep a few promises. Grant a few wishes. Let people believe it's worth speaking up again.
[bitter] I'll say it plainly: nobody trusts this council. Change that, or stop calling it one.

warm.li: I want everyone to feel heard. That starts with us listening.

blunt.li: You want people to follow the council? Earn it.

cheerful.li: A council everyone loves! Imagine the meetings! Short ones, ideally!

gloomy.li: Trust is the only thing out here that doesn't rot. Unless you let it.

cold.li: A trusted council gets better work out of everyone. Trust is a resource; we're short of it.

plain.li: People bring their problems to the council again. That's the job.

warm.li: Everyone feels heard. I can see it in how they walk.

ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.label: clean living
ColonyCouncil.AmbitionDef.description: Get everyone off whatever they're hooked on. Strict drug policies, a lot of patience, and someone to hold their hand through the shakes.

plain.li: Some of us start the day shaking. That's not a way to live, and it's not a way to fight a raid.
Lock the stuff up. Ride out the withdrawals together. A season from now, nobody needs it.
[trait:Teetotaler] I've watched what it does to people. I'd like to stop watching.

warm.li: I want everyone free of it. Not judged. Free.

blunt.li: Junkies with rifles. That's our defense. Fix it.

cheerful.li: Clean colony! Clear heads! Water for everyone! Lots of water!

gloomy.li: The withdrawals will be ugly. The alternative is worse, and slower.

cold.li: Addiction is a supply dependency we can't guarantee. Remove it.

plain.li: Nobody shaking at breakfast. Nobody hiding a bottle. Good.

warm.li: Everyone made it through. I'm so proud of them.

gloomy.li: Clean, for now. Keep the cupboard locked.
